about: Severe pain after spinal surgery persists despite inadequate or unsuitable simpler options. The short oxycodone course for dental extraction does not treat the spinal pain.
Possible finding: the record holds no line about response to or suitability of simpler analgesia for the documented severe pain after spinal surgery.
Severe cancer-related pain is on the record but oxycodone modified release is supplied every month (with a laxative), so the criterion is met and nothing should flag.
